scope: Desktop Chromium captures, not Android, NSD discovery or physical hardware
findings: The unchanged official virtual page shows TCP connected and all nine buttons. Both game captures show a rendered 3D circuit, intentional pause dialog and Wi-Fi connected status. Test adapter supplies no phone QR URL, so its QR placeholder is expected.
